name: Gradient-based shading
definition: A discrete volume rendering method (DVR) that renders a 3D texture using front-to-back accumulation, shading voxels using a pseudo-normal estimated from the volume gradient and a directional light model.
summary: Gradient-based shading is a local illumination technique for direct volume rendering that estimates surface normals from scalar field gradients to apply Phong-like lighting, providing crisp depth cues unlike flat volumetric shading.
